tasks.gr12-evolution-natural-selection-t3: Topic: Evolution by Natural Selection. Cover Lamarckism, Darwinism, natural selection, variation, overproduction, competition, survival of the fittest, speciation, punctuated equilibrium and evidence for evolution. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare explanatory theories and apply natural selection to real biological examples.
tasks.gr12-human-evolution-t3: Topic: Human Evolution. Cover hominid characteristics, fossil evidence from Australopithecus to Homo, bipedalism, brain-size trends, cultural development, common ancestry and the Out of Africa hypothesis. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret fossils and explain major evolutionary trends in humans.
tasks.gr12-revision-trial-examinations-t3: Topic: Revision and Trial Examinations. Integrate Grade 12 Life Sciences content from human reproduction, responding to the environment, homeostasis, DNA, meiosis, genetics and evolution. Ask Grade 12 learners to answer mixed data-response and structured questions under trial-exam conditions and to justify biological reasoning clearly.
